dead_code.name: Metal Distortion
dead_code.note: Legacy/unreachable; Metal voice now Distortion mode index 3

findings.title: Missing oversized-block capacity guard before JUCE Oversampling
findings.evidence: BoostPedal.h:199 calls oversampler.processSamplesUp(block) with no 'numSamples > preparedBlockSize' guard; no preparedBlockSize member; initProcessing sized to prepared block (line 142). Host block larger than prepared can read/write past oversampler capacity (OOB/UB/assert). Parity gap vs P13C amps and Overdrive.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture preparedBlockSize in prepareToPlay; add oversized-block bypass guard + realtime fallback counter before upsampling, mirroring Overdrive/amps.

findings.title: Missing input NaN/Inf scrub allows biquad state latch
findings.evidence: No scrubInvalidSamples at block entry; raw data fed into inputHP/midPeak/presShelf/airLP/dcBlock biquads (BoostPedal.h:236+). NaN/Inf poisons z1/z2 permanently; containBoostOutput zeroes only the current output sample, not filter state -> persistent silence, no recovery.
findings.recommended_fix: Add scrubInvalidSamples (finite->0) at processBlock entry, like Overdrive/Distortion/Fuzz/Neural.

findings.title: No NaN/Inf scrub; detector/gateGain/lookahead can latch NaN
findings.evidence: NoiseGatePedal.h:253+ processBlock has no input scrub. Non-finite input -> detector envelope NaN -> detectorDb NaN -> gateGain NaN and lookahead ring stores NaN with no reset/recovery path.
findings.recommended_fix: Add input scrub + isfinite reset for detector, gateGain, and lookahead state on non-finite.

findings.title: Missing juce::ScopedNoDenormals in processBlock
findings.evidence: grep shows ScopedNoDenormals present only in Boost/Overdrive/Metal/Neural. Distortion, Fuzz, Compressor, Noise Gate lack it -> biquad/envelope decay tails on silence cause denormal CPU spikes; Compressor and Gate operate on silence by design.
findings.recommended_fix: Add juce::ScopedNoDenormals as first statement of each processBlock (matches P13B/P13C hardening pattern).

findings.title: Unregistered MetalDistortionPedal lacks guards
findings.evidence: Not in PedalRegistry; PedalCatalog.h:40 maps 'Metal Distortion'->'Distortion'. File lacks oversized guard, input scrub, output containment and resizes scratch in processBlock. Latent only.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete legacy file or bring to parity to prevent accidental re-registration.

findings.title: Test gaps for Boost oversized + drive NaN/Inf + dynamics near-silence
findings.evidence: runP1OversizedFallback covers Compressor/Distortion/Fuzz/Neural but not Boost; no NaN/Inf-input recovery test for drives; no denormal/near-silence finite test for Compressor/Gate decay tails.
findings.recommended_fix: After F001-F004 land: add Boost oversized + drive NaN/Inf recovery + Compressor/Gate near-silence finite tests; assert SR-change re-prepare.
